title: Dual-Supply Bundle Bonus: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Renewals at Premises Taking Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
**Programme term.** A bundle bonus is added to a Commercial Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit for businesses that also take Beacon Ridge Small Business Electricity Supply at the same premise:

- when the Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on that premise is active and the business's Small Business Electricity Supply bills carry at least 10 energy charge lines whose billing period start is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date, the bonus is $50.00;
- when that agreement is active and those bills carry fewer such lines, the bonus is $25.00;
- when no Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on that premise is active, there is no bundle bonus.

The bundle bonus is added to the loyalty credit after the base credit has been multiplied, and the bonus itself is not multiplied. The status is read from the Small Business Electricity Supply agreement record for the gas site's premise; the energy charge lines are read from the business's Small Business Electricity Supply bill lines.

## Bonus by electricity holding

| Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on the same premise | Electricity energy charge lines in the twelve-month window | Bundle bonus |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 10 or more | $50.00 |
| Active | 9 or fewer | $25.00 |
| Not active, or none on the premise | Any | None |

## Illustrations (hypothetical, acceptance date 2025-08-12)

- A diner's gas site has an active Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, and its electricity bills show 11 energy charge lines with billing period starts from 2024-08-13 onward: $50.00.
- A second diner has an active electricity agreement that began recently, with 4 such lines: $25.00.
- A third diner's electricity agreement on the premise closed last year: no bundle bonus, however many electricity lines it carried.
- An electricity energy charge line whose billing period start is 2024-08-12 falls outside the window.
